note: Medicine Bow NF campground at the confluence of Douglas and Pelton Creeks on the edge of the Platte River Wilderness, 8.7 miles up FR 898 off WY-230. A single loop in a stand of lodgepole the 2020 Mullen Fire spared; some sites overlook the creek meadow. Pack out trash; no stock in the campground (unloading area at the trailhead). --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov 10250619 read: 14 sites (4 pull-through, driveways 32-99 ft), no hookups, hand pump (July-Sept), 2 vault toilets, 14-day limit, $14.
